ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a schematic diagram of the lungs and surrounding membrane layers, with labels E, C, A on the right side. The leader line of label E points to the outer boundary on the outside of the lung, near the chest wall; the leader line of label A points to a more inward boundary, close to the surface of the lung. Between the two boundaries is shown a narrow gap. Reasoning: In the anatomy of the lung, the narrow space between the outer parietal pleura and the inner visceral pleura is called the pleural cavity or pleural space. Therefore, what is between E and A is pleural space.
